name: Lindenbrook Physiotherapy
description: Physiotherapy and sports injury clinics in the fictional city of Kestrel Bay.

items.title: Published patient harm finding
items.content: The health ombudsman publicly found on 2026-03-26 that a Lindenbrook physio missed signs of a spinal cord compression in a patient over 4 visits; the clinic paid $18,500 in redress. Finding LBP-OMB-0326.

items.title: Session prices
items.content: A first assessment is $76 and follow-ups $59; sports massage is $64 for 45 minutes. Price list LBP-PRC-76.

items.title: Clinic room allocation
items.content: Room 3 has the treadmill; the hydro pool is booked by Ciaran Doyle in slots from 07:05. Sheet LBP-RM-3.

items.title: Clinical notes deadline
items.content: Notes must be written within 26 hours of each session and audited monthly. Rules LBP-NTS-26.

items.title: Contract with Kestrel Bay FC
items.content: Kestrel Bay FC pays $212,000 a season for 2 physios at all matches; the club wants exclusivity from 2027-07-01. Contract LBP-KBF-0701-K.

items.title: Physio suspension
items.content: Physio Anton Weir was suspended on 2026-10-06 after a patient complaint of inappropriate touching; police have been told. File LBP-HR-1006-W.
